situations.title: 알레르기 재확인
situations.tagline: Before induction, let's reconfirm every allergy on her band and chart.
situations.brief: 마취 유도 전 환자의 알레르기를 다시 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's read back her allergies before induction.
Any reaction to antibiotics or latex?
I'll flag these in the room for everyone.

situations.title: 흔한 원인 약물 인지
situations.tagline: The usual triggers here are muscle relaxants, antibiotics, and latex, so let's stay alert.
situations.brief: 마취 중 아나필락시스의 흔한 원인 약물을 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: NMBAs and antibiotics are top triggers.
Latex is still a common cause in the OR.
Watch closely right after we give these.
goals: 투여 직후 반응을 주의 깊게 관찰한다

situations.title: epinephrine 위치 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm where the epinephrine is before we induce.
keyPhrases: Where's the epi if we need it fast?
Let's have a syringe drawn up and labeled.
The code cart is right outside the door.

situations.title: 활력 급변 감시
situations.tagline: Keep an eye on the monitor, I want to catch any sudden vital change early.
keyPhrases: Call out any sudden drop in pressure.
Watch the heart rate and end-tidal CO2.
Early recognition buys us time.

situations.title: 피부 발진 관찰
situations.tagline: Lift the drape edge and check her skin for any flushing or hives.
keyPhrases: Look for flushing, hives, or wheals.
Check areas the drapes are hiding.
Skin signs can be the first clue.

situations.title: 산소 공급 준비
situations.tagline: Let's have high-flow oxygen ready in case her airway reacts.
situations.brief: 기도 반응에 대비해 산소 공급을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Set up for 100 percent oxygen if needed.
Check the circuit and the bag are ready.
Suction should be within reach too.

situations.title: 저혈압·빈맥 초기
situations.tagline: Her pressure's dropping and she's tachycardic, this could be an early reaction.
situations.brief: 초기 순환 변화인 저혈압과 빈맥에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Pressure's falling and heart rate's climbing.
Let's open the fluids and tell the surgeon.
Could this be the start of anaphylaxis?
goals: 초기 순환 변화를 아나필락시스 가능성으로 의심한다

situations.title: 기관지 경련 감시
situations.tagline: I'm hearing wheeze and the peak pressures are up, watch for bronchospasm.
keyPhrases: There's wheezing and rising airway pressures.
It's getting hard to ventilate her.
This looks like bronchospasm, let's escalate.
goals: 환기 저항 증가를 보고하고 대응을 시작한다

situations.title: 원인 물질 중단
situations.tagline: Stop the antibiotic infusion now, it may be the trigger.
situations.brief: 아나필락시스가 의심되면 원인 물질을 즉시 중단하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop whatever we just started.
Clamp the antibiotic and swap the line.
Remove any latex from contact too.

situations.title: 항생제 유발 반응
situations.tagline: She reacted right after the cefazolin, let's treat this as antibiotic anaphylaxis.
keyPhrases: The timing points to the antibiotic.
Stop the infusion and note the dose and time.
Let's start the anaphylaxis pathway.

situations.title: 근이완제 반응
situations.tagline: This started seconds after the rocuronium, so suspect an NMBA reaction.
keyPhrases: NMBAs are a leading cause of OR anaphylaxis.
Onset right after induction fits the picture.
Document which relaxant and the exact time.

situations.title: 조영제·라텍스 감별
situations.tagline: We gave contrast and there's latex in the room, let's work out which is the culprit.
keyPhrases: Was it the contrast or a latex exposure?
Latex reactions often build more slowly.
Let's remove latex and note the contrast timing.

situations.title: 중증도 등급 사정
situations.tagline: Let's grade this reaction so we match the treatment to the severity.
keyPhrases: Grade one is skin only, grade three is life-threatening.
She has hypotension, so this is at least grade three.
The grade drives the epi dose and route.

situations.title: 수액 부하 대응
situations.tagline: She needs volume, let's bolus fluids wide open through both lines.
keyPhrases: Run both IVs wide open.
She may need liters, not milliliters.
Squeeze the bags and get pressure lines ready.

situations.title: 이상성 반응 감시
situations.tagline: She looks better now, but let's watch closely for a biphasic rebound.
keyPhrases: A second wave can hit hours later.
Keep her monitored and don't rush the discharge.
Have epi and fluids stay at the bedside.

situations.title: 아나필락시스 쇼크
situations.tagline: She's in anaphylactic shock, call it, we're running the algorithm now.
keyPhrases: This is anaphylactic shock, get the epi drawn.
Stop all triggers and go 100 percent oxygen.
Call for help and start the algorithm.

situations.title: epinephrine 투여
situations.tagline: Give epinephrine now and let's titrate to her response.
keyPhrases: Push epi and note the dose and time.
Repeat every few minutes if she doesn't respond.
Read the dose back so we're closed-loop.

situations.title: 순환 허탈 CPR 준비
situations.tagline: She's losing her pulse, get the code cart and be ready to start compressions.
keyPhrases: Pulse is fading, prep for compressions.
Get the defibrillator pads on now.
Assign roles, someone owns the airway.
goals: 역할을 분담해 즉시 시작할 수 있게 한다

situations.title: 기도 부종 폐쇄
situations.tagline: Her airway is swelling shut, we need to secure it before we lose it.
keyPhrases: The airway is edematous and closing.
Get the difficult airway cart and a smaller tube.
Be ready for a surgical airway if we can't intubate.

situations.title: 난치성 쇼크 승압
situations.tagline: She's not responding to epi, let's start a vasopressor infusion.
keyPhrases: She's refractory, we need an epi or norepi drip.
Consider glucagon if she's on beta blockers.
Keep the fluids running alongside the pressor.
goals: 난치성 쇼크를 인지하고 승압제 지속 투여를 시작한다

situations.title: 위기 후 중환자 이송
situations.tagline: She's stabilized but fragile, let's set up a safe transfer to the ICU.
situations.brief: 위기 후 중환자실 이송을 안전하게 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: She needs ICU-level monitoring after this.
Keep the drips running and the airway secured.
Bring epi and the transport monitor for the trip.
